description: This Java class 'RenderResult' encapsulates the result of rendering a layout in Android Studio, including image, view hierarchy, and related metadata.

classes.name: RenderResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of rendering a layout, including image, view hierarchy, and related metadata.

methods.name: createBlank
methods.description: Creates a new blank RenderResult associated with a given PsiFile and optional logger.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the RenderSession associated with this result.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the RenderLogger used for this render result.

methods.name: getHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the RenderedViewHierarchy, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the RenderedImage of the render result.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the PsiFile associated with this render result.

methods.name: getRenderService
methods.description: Returns the RenderService used for rendering.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module associated with the render result.

methods.name: getIncludedWithin
methods.description: Returns the IncludeReference indicating if this render is included within another.

methods.name: setIncludedWithin
methods.description: Sets the IncludeReference indicating if this render is included within another.
